```
const express = require('express');
const cors = require('cors');
const multer = require('multer');
const sharp = require('sharp');
const PDFDocument = require('pdfkit');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid');

const app = express();
const PORT = 3000;

// Admin wachtwoord - VERANDER DIT!
const ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'BETA';

// Middleware
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.static('.', {
    setHeaders: (res, filepath) => {
        if (filepath.endsWith('.js')) {
            res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/javascript');
        }
    }
})); // Serve static files from current directory

// Directories
const UPLOADS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'uploads');
const THUMBNAILS_DIR = path.join(__dirname, 'uploads', 'thumbnails');
const DATA_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'posters.json');

// Maak directories aan als ze niet bestaan
[UPLOADS_DIR, THUMBNAILS_DIR].forEach(dir => {
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    }
});

// Multer configuratie voor file uploads
const storage = multer.diskStorage({
    destination: (req, file, cb) => {
        cb(null, UPLOADS_DIR);
    },
    filename: (req, file, cb) => {
        const uniqueName = `${uuidv4()}${path.extname(file.originalname)}`;
        cb(null, uniqueName);
    }
});

const upload = multer({
    storage,
    limits: { fileSize: 100 * 1024 * 1024 }, // 100MB max
    fileFilter: (req, file, cb) => {
        const allowedTypes = /jpeg|jpg|png|pdf/;
        const extname = allowedTypes.test(path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase());
        const mimetype = allowedTypes.test(file.mimetype) || file.mimetype === 'application/pdf';
        
        if (extname && mimetype) {
            cb(null, true);
        } else {
            cb(new Error('Alleen JPEG, PNG en PDF bestanden zijn toegestaan'));
        }
    }
});

// Helper functies voor data opslag
function readPosters() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(DATA_FILE)) {
        return [];
    }
    try {
        const data = fs.readFileSync(DATA_FILE, 'utf8');
        return JSON.parse(data);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error reading posters:', error);
        return [];
    }
}

function writePosters(posters) {
    try {
        fs.writeFileSync(DATA_FILE, JSON.stringify(posters, null, 2));
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error writing posters:', error);
    }
}

// PDF formaat afmetingen in pixels bij 300 DPI
const PDF_SIZES = {
    A4: { width: 2480, height: 3508 },
    A3: { width: 3508, height: 4961 },
    A2: { width: 4961, height: 7016 },
    A1: { width: 7016, height: 9933 },
    A0: { width: 9933, height: 14043 }
};

// Middleware voor admin authenticatie
function authenticateAdmin(req, res, next) {
    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
    
    if (!authHeader) {
        return res.status(401).json({ message: 'Geen authenticatie' });
    }
    
    const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];
    if (token !== ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
        return res.status(403).json({ message: 'Ongeldig wachtwoord' });
    }
    
    next();
}

// ==================== API ROUTES ====================

// GET alle posters
app.get('/api/posters', (req, res) => {
    const posters = readPosters();
    res.json(posters);
});

// GET specifieke poster
app.get('/api/posters/:id', (req, res) => {
    const posters = readPosters();
    const poster = posters.find(p => p.id === req.params.id);
    
    if (!poster) {
        return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Poster niet gevonden' });
    }
    
    res.json(poster);
});

// POST admin login
app.post('/api/admin/login', (req, res) => {
    const { password } = req.body;
    
    if (password === ADMIN_PASSWORD) {
        res.json({ success: true });
    } else {
        res.status(401).json({ message: 'Onjuist wachtwoord' });
    }
});

// POST upload nieuwe poster (admin only) - multiple files
app.post('/api/admin/upload', authenticateAdmin, upload.fields([
    { name: 'jpeg', maxCount: 1 },
    { name: 'pdfMedium', maxCount: 1 },
    { name: 'pdfLarge', maxCount: 1 }
]), async (req, res) => {
    try {
        if (!req.files || !req.files.jpeg || !req.files.pdfMedium || !req.files.pdfLarge) {
            return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Alle bestanden zijn verplicht' });
        }
        
        const { title, description } = req.body;
        
        if (!title) {
            // Cleanup uploaded files
            Object.values(req.files).flat().forEach(file => {
                if (fs.existsSync(file.path)) fs.unlinkSync(file.path);
            });
            return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Titel is verplicht' });
        }
        
        const jpegFile = req.files.jpeg[0];
        const pdfMediumFile = req.files.pdfMedium[0];
        const pdfLargeFile = req.files.pdfLarge[0];
        
        // Genereer thumbnail van JPEG
        const thumbnailName = `thumb_${jpegFile.filename}`;
        const thumbnailPath = path.join(THUMBNAILS_DIR, thumbnailName);
        
        await sharp(jpegFile.path)
            .resize(400, 566, { fit: 'cover' })
            .jpeg({ quality: 85 })
            .toFile(thumbnailPath);
        
        // Maak poster object
        const poster = {
            id: uuidv4(),
            title,
            description: description || '',
            jpegFilename: jpegFile.filename,
            pdfMediumFilename: pdfMediumFile.filename,
            pdfLargeFilename: pdfLargeFile.filename,
            thumbnail: `/uploads/thumbnails/${thumbnailName}`,
            uploadDate: new Date().toISOString(),
            downloads: 0
        };
        
        // Sla op in JSON
        const posters = readPosters();
        posters.push(poster);
        writePosters(posters);
        
        res.json({ success: true, poster });
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Upload error:', error);
        
        // Cleanup bij fout
        if (req.files) {
            Object.values(req.files).flat().forEach(file => {
                if (fs.existsSync(file.path)) fs.unlinkSync(file.path);
            });
        }
        
        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Upload mislukt', error: error.message });
    }
});

// DELETE poster (admin only)
app.delete('/api/admin/posters/:id', authenticateAdmin, (req, res) => {
    try {
        const posters = readPosters();
        const posterIndex = posters.findIndex(p => p.id === req.params.id);
        
        if (posterIndex === -1) {
            return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Poster niet gevonden' });
        }
        
        const poster = posters[posterIndex];
        
        // Verwijder alle bestanden (backwards compatible met oude structuur)
        if (poster.jpegFilename) {
            const jpegPath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, poster.jpegFilename);
            if (fs.existsSync(jpegPath)) fs.unlinkSync(jpegPath);
        }
        if (poster.pdfMediumFilename) {
            const pdfMediumPath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, poster.pdfMediumFilename);
            if (fs.existsSync(pdfMediumPath)) fs.unlinkSync(pdfMediumPath);
        }
        if (poster.pdfLargeFilename) {
            const pdfLargePath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, poster.pdfLargeFilename);
            if (fs.existsSync(pdfLargePath)) fs.unlinkSync(pdfLargePath);
        }
        // Oude structuur (filename alleen)
        if (poster.filename) {
            const oldPath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, poster.filename);
            if (fs.existsSync(oldPath)) fs.unlinkSync(oldPath);
        }
        // Thumbnail
        if (poster.thumbnail) {
            const thumbnailPath = path.join(__dirname, poster.thumbnail);
            if (fs.existsSync(thumbnailPath)) fs.unlinkSync(thumbnailPath);
        }
        
        // Verwijder uit array
        posters.splice(posterIndex, 1);
        writePosters(posters);
        
        res.json({ success: true });
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Delete error:', error);
        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Verwijderen mislukt', error: error.message });
    }
});

// GET download poster
app.get('/api/download/:id', async (req, res) => {
    try {
        const { format, size } = req.query;
        const posters = readPosters();
        const poster = posters.find(p => p.id === req.params.id);
        
        if (!poster) {
            return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Poster niet gevonden' });
        }
        
        // Update download count
        const posterIndex = posters.findIndex(p => p.id === req.params.id);
        posters[posterIndex].downloads = (posters[posterIndex].downloads || 0) + 1;
        writePosters(posters);
        
        // JPEG download
        if (format === 'jpeg') {
            // Backwards compatible: gebruik jpegFilename of fallback naar filename
            const filename = poster.jpegFilename || poster.filename;
            
            if (!filename) {
                return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Geen JPEG bestand gevonden' });
            }
            
            const jpegPath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, filename);
            
            if (!fs.existsSync(jpegPath)) {
                return res.status(404).json({ message: 'JPEG niet gevonden op schijf' });
            }
            
            res.set('Content-Type', 'image/jpeg');
            res.set('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${poster.title}.jpg"`);
            return res.sendFile(jpegPath);
        }
        
        // PDF download (normale PDFs)
        if (format === 'pdf') {
            let pdfFilename;
            let fileName;
            
            if (size === 'A3') {
                pdfFilename = poster.pdfMediumFilename;
                fileName = `${poster.title}_Medium.pdf`;
            } else if (size === 'A0') {
                pdfFilename = poster.pdfLargeFilename;
                fileName = `${poster.title}_Groot.pdf`;
            }
            
            if (!pdfFilename) {
                return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Deze poster heeft geen PDF bestanden (oude structuur)' });
            }
            
            const pdfPath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, pdfFilename);
            
            if (!fs.existsSync(pdfPath)) {
                return res.status(404).json({ message: 'PDF niet gevonden op schijf' });
            }
            
            res.set('Content-Type', 'application/pdf');
            res.set('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${fileName}"`);
            return res.sendFile(pdfPath);
        }
        
        // PDF Drukklaar met bleed en snijtekens
        if (format === 'pdf-print') {
            // Backwards compatible: gebruik jpegFilename of fallback naar filename
            const sourceFilename = poster.jpegFilename || poster.filename;
            
            if (!sourceFilename) {
                return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Geen bronbestand gevonden voor drukklare PDF' });
            }
            
            const jpegPath = path.join(UPLOADS_DIR, sourceFilename);
            
            if (!fs.existsSync(jpegPath)) {
                return res.status(404).json({ message: 'Bronbestand niet gevonden op schijf' });
            }
            
            const pdfSize = PDF_SIZES[size];
            
            if (!pdfSize) {
                return res.status(400).json({ message: 'Ongeldig formaat. Gebruik A3 of A0.' });
            }
            
            const bleed = 3 * 300 / 25.4; // 3mm in pixels bij 300 DPI
            const cropMarkLength = 5 * 300 / 25.4; // 5mm
            const cropMarkOffset = 2 * 300 / 25.4; // 2mm
            
            // Totale afmetingen inclusief bleed
            const totalWidth = pdfSize.width + (bleed * 2);
            const totalHeight = pdfSize.height + (bleed * 2);
            
            // Resize en extend image met bleed
            const imageBuffer = await sharp(jpegPath)
                .resize(pdfSize.width, pdfSize.height, { fit: 'cover' })
                .extend({
                    top: Math.round(bleed),
                    bottom: Math.round(bleed),
                    left: Math.round(bleed),
                    right: Math.round(bleed),
                    background: { r: 255, g: 255, b: 255, alpha: 1 }
                })
                .toBuffer();
            
            // Creëer PDF met bleed
            const doc = new PDFDocument({
                size: [totalWidth * 72 / 300, totalHeight * 72 / 300],
                margins: { top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0 }
            });
            
            res.set('Content-Type', 'application/pdf');
            const downloadFilename = `${poster.title}_${size}_Drukklaar.pdf`;
            res.set('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${downloadFilename}"`);
            
            doc.pipe(res);
            
            // Voeg afbeelding toe
            doc.image(imageBuffer, 0, 0, {
                width: totalWidth * 72 / 300,
                height: totalHeight * 72 / 300
            });
            
            // Teken snijtekens (crop marks)
            doc.strokeColor('black').lineWidth(0.5);
            
            const bleedPt = bleed * 72 / 300;
            const cropMarkLengthPt = cropMarkLength * 72 / 300;
            const cropMarkOffsetPt = cropMarkOffset * 72 / 300;
            const widthPt = pdfSize.width * 72 / 300;
            const heightPt = pdfSize.height * 72 / 300;
            
            // Linksboven
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt - cropMarkLengthPt, bleedPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt, bleedPt)
               .stroke();
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt, bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt - cropMarkLengthPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt, bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt)
               .stroke();
            
            // Rechtsboven
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt + widthPt + cropMarkOffsetPt, bleedPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt + widthPt + cropMarkOffsetPt + cropMarkLengthPt, bleedPt)
               .stroke();
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt + widthPt, bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt - cropMarkLengthPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt + widthPt, bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt)
               .stroke();
            
            // Linksonder
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt - cropMarkLengthPt, bleedPt + heightPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt - cropMarkOffsetPt, bleedPt + heightPt)
               .stroke();
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt, bleedPt + heightPt + cropMarkOffsetPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt, bleedPt + heightPt + cropMarkOffsetPt + cropMarkLengthPt)
               .stroke();
            
            // Rechtsonder
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt + widthPt + cropMarkOffsetPt, bleedPt + heightPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt + widthPt + cropMarkOffsetPt + cropMarkLengthPt, bleedPt + heightPt)
               .stroke();
            doc.moveTo(bleedPt + widthPt, bleedPt + heightPt + cropMarkOffsetPt)
               .lineTo(bleedPt + widthPt, bleedPt + heightPt + cropMarkOffsetPt + cropMarkLengthPt)
               .stroke();
            
            doc.end();
        }
        
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Download error:', error);
        res.status(500).json({ message: 'Download mislukt', error: error.message });
    }
});

// Serve uploaded files
app.use('/uploads', express.static(UPLOADS_DIR));

// Start server
app.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
    console.log(`\n🚀 Server draait op http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    console.log(`📱 Mobiel: http://192.168.0.211:${PORT}`);
    console.log(`📊 Admin dashboard: http://localhost:${PORT}/admin.html`);
    console.log(`🔐 Admin wachtwoord: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD} (verander dit in server.js!)\n`);
});
```
